{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', sales.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:', (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column: is it string with commas?
print('\nSample of revenue values:', sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print('\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):', len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print('\nNumber of refunded orders:', len(refunded))

# Check if channel is randomised
print('\nChannel distribution:\n', sales['channel'].value_counts())
print('\nChannel vs customer_segment:\n', pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment']))"}
